criteria.detail: Every persisted payload and referenced file is checksummed.
AST check of direct agent-class calls.
Actual train/validation evidence audited before any training.
Exact supporting quotes resolve to checksummed snapshots; recommendations remain hypotheses.
Curated excerpts alone do not demonstrate web retrieval.
Test metrics are excluded from search and configuration selection.
Conventional baseline uses the same seed and selected splits; negative deltas are retained.
At least three completed seeds, with a shared validation-selected configuration.
Validation-calibrated abstention with a persistent benchmark review queue.
Every promoted stage has an independent reviewer report.
Decision source and stage are recorded; exact prompts/schema/results are retained.
Requires passing tests and measured fault injection for this exact source tree.
A transcript alone is not proof that retraining reproduces predictions and metrics.
Every unresolved reviewer issue requires an explicit approved mitigation.
Requires named independent demonstrator/reviewer, bound predictions and checksummed environment evidence.

unresolved_reviewer_issues: Ambiguity among visually similar histology classes (background/debris/mucus, adipose/background, smooth muscle/stroma) at 28×28 resolution is a known task limitation; ensure evaluation metrics account for inter-class confusion

Inter-class visual ambiguity at 28×28 resolution (background/debris/mucus, adipose/background, smooth-muscle/stroma) requires per-class F1 and confusion-matrix reporting in downstream evaluation, not only macro accuracy
OOD aggregate computation rule (arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs) not explicitly encoded in this artefact; must be specified in downstream evaluation config
OOD aggregate must be computed as the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC; test set is from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K)
Parameter budget for compact_transformer stated as 1–4 M in this artefact vs. 3 M hard cap in the compact-transformer proposal; must be reconciled before model construction
Prior-art parameter budget: CCT idea cites 1–4 M vs compact-transformer proposal cap of 3 M; reconcile in downstream specs
Profiling stage action=revise: downstream evaluation must account for inter-class visual ambiguity at 28×28 resolution (background/debris/mucus, adipose/background, smooth-muscle/stroma)
Smooth muscle (F1=0.692) and cancer-associated stroma (F1=0.717) are the weakest classes; adipose↔smooth muscle confusion (402 samples) dominates error budget.
Test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K); OOD aggregate should be computed as the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC
Three classes (adipose, smooth muscle, cancer-associated stroma) have F1 below 0.85, which may affect downstream clinical utility if these distinctions matter for the intended use case.

Two extension proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain pending_review; built-in augmentations in the representation plan are unaffected but the extensions must be resolved before any non-primitive augmentation is applied

Val-test accuracy gap of ~11.2 pp (0.9946 val vs 0.8827 test) is large; likely distribution shift rather than overfitting given close train/val losses, but should be tracked in OOD robustness reporting.
